title: Redis
text: Redis is an in-memory data store used for caches and job queues. Cached entries can expire with a time to live.

title: Vector search
text: Qdrant stores embedding vectors and retrieves nearest neighbors using vector similarity. Payload metadata can filter results.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
text: Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines ranked dense and sparse search results by adding weighted reciprocal ranks. It does not require comparable raw scores.

title: Cross-encoder reranking
text: A cross-encoder scores a query and passage together. A reranker reorders retrieved candidates but cannot recover missing candidates.

title: Document chunking
text: Chunking splits a long document into smaller passages. Overlapping adjacent chunks can preserve evidence near passage boundaries.

title: Background jobs
text: BullMQ schedules background jobs through Redis. Failed jobs may be retried with exponential backoff to reduce repeated load.

title: Grounded answers
text: A faithful generated answer supports its factual claims with the provided source context. Unsupported claims are hallucinations.

title: Paired bootstrap
text: Paired bootstrap resamples query indices with replacement. Both systems use the same sampled queries to estimate uncertainty in a metric difference.

title: SQLite
text: SQLite is an embedded relational database stored in a file. SQL transactions provide atomic updates to document status records.

title: Judge reproducibility
text: A language model judge should use a fixed model revision and rubric. Zero temperature alone does not guarantee reproducible judgments.

title: Circuit breaker
text: A circuit breaker stops calls to a repeatedly failing dependency and probes it again after a cooldown period.

title: Idempotent ingestion
text: Idempotent ingestion gives the same stored result when a job is executed more than once. Deterministic chunk IDs prevent duplicate records.
